definition: Miss AI was an international artificial intelligence beauty pageant run by the British company Fanvue.
details: It is the first beauty pageant for AI-generated personas.

explainer.lead: Miss AI was an international artificial intelligence beauty pageant run by the British company Fanvue. It matters as the first beauty pageant for AI-generated personas.

tiers.eli5: It was a contest where the contestants weren't people but computer-generated characters.
tiers.practitioner: Not applicable in the usual engineering sense: it is a public event rather than a technique engineers deploy. A relevant pitfall of such contests is that judging AI-generated personas raises questions the format itself does not address.
tiers.paperLevel: There is no formal definition; it is described as an international artificial intelligence beauty pageant run by the British company Fanvue and the first beauty pageant for AI-generated personas.

explainer.example: AI-generated personas were entered as contestants in an international competition organized by Fanvue.
